testProvenance.ordinaryFlows: Three original-model/public-pilot record flows execute a real different-material trial swap, B exact undo, same-ID/same-cells repair, goal-ready unsubmitted board, focused FORGE and explicit winning submission. Durations 34.1833/39.9333/46.85 seconds are pure-model ordinary-input simulation, not browser recording durations.
testProvenance.ordinaryEdgeStates: All39 canvas states come from unchanged authored puzzles and create/step inputs. They include held source/destination, blocked held FORGE submission, both cancellation actions, actual rejected submissions, three kinds of repeated-rejection loss and90-second timeout. No forced assignment, forced phase, synthetic geometry or hidden author solution is used.
testProvenance.recipeHeatCounterexamples: The public planner goal recipes-without-heat finds ordinary swap sequences independently from public materials and geometry. Each of three resulting7/7 layouts has an actual loop with a closing edge. A real FORGE action rejects it for heat and leaves assignment unchanged.
testProvenance.runtimeLayouts: Two unmodified source-runtime sequences use Enter, Space and P for actual menu/play/pick/pause at960/1280. Thirteen public snapshots per viewport are deliberately served with scratch-only create replacement and no-op step, solely for DOM/footer layout. These26 snapshots are not browser-earned outcomes or restored simulation. No APK/device/video claim.
testProvenance.readOnly: Deeply frozen states remain unchanged. Throwing getters cover every internal underscore state field, hypothetical hidden/solution fields, extra cell truth fields and all PureModel API access. Different external time/raw inputs produce identical render commands, HUD and result. Actual occupied tile sprites always match the seven public cell material/ID assignments.
testProvenance.generationHistory: Prior e6c549 art reports and actual candidate screenshots remain historical. Candidate review found an orphan final character in960 A-help. Only controls.a was shortened as authorized, with an exact reverse-byte proof. This fresh39-state/26-fixture pass binds dbf871 game and unchanged a51bb model/1ea6 pilot; no prior game evidence is relabeled. The unchanged original icon assets retain their separate already-rendered SVG preview.

confirmedWording: Seven actual occupied slots and unique physical tile IDs remain visible during selection and holding; picking is not a swap.
The selected recipe displays only its specified neighboring material as the exact constraint; the other material counts are descriptive.
Each material retains its Cu/Fe/Ag glyph and unique cell/tile IDs, with check/cross local-condition symbols in addition to colors.
World direction priorities 1 E, 2 SE, 3 SW, 4 W, 5 NW, 6 NE are fixed. Actual highlighted edges come only from the public heat trace, including loop closing edges.
Mold absorbs heat and has no outlet; its independent local recipe still must be satisfied.
All three ordinary public-planner counterexamples satisfy 7/7 recipes but loop; they remain playing and an actual FORGE submission is rejected for heat.
All three ordinary goal-ready states remain playing until empty-handed A at FORGE; successful submission is explicit.
Trial swap, undo and repair preserve exact unique IDs and cells; undo returns the original derived board and heat trace without refunding time.
